def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    marker_rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in grid[r])]
    marker_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=2).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (2,bg)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    if marker_rows:
        mr=marker_rows[0]
        lo=min(r for r,c in pts); hi=max(r for r,c in pts)
        if hi < mr: delta=mr-1-hi; sign=1
        else: delta=mr+1-lo; sign=-1
        moved=[(r+sign*delta,c,grid[r][c]) for r,c in pts]
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=bg
        for r,c,v in moved: out[r][c]=v
        line=(min(r+sign*delta for r,c in pts)-1 if sign==1 else max(r+sign*delta for r,c in pts)+1)
        out[line]=[8]*w
    else:

        lo=min(c for r,c in pts); hi=max(c for r,c in pts)
        if hi < mc: delta=mc-1-hi; sign=1
